name: auth-failure
description: A tenant that rejects the credential outright: the datasearch answers 401 on the first call. The run must end with a printed diagnostic and zero assets rather than looping, retrying, or aborting -- and the request must carry the token in BOTH the documented Netskope-Api-Token header and the Authorization: Bearer form, so a tenant honoring either one authenticates. Skips namespaced_ids for consistency with the other netskope scenarios (no assets are emitted).  The task now ENDS IN ERROR rather than reporting a successful run with zero assets: a refused credential and an empty tenant are otherwise the same result, and only the exit status separates them.
